enforcement_note: This graph documents the intended task workflow. It is not enforced by `se update`; a task status may be set to any schema enum value (subject to schema rules, e.g. BLOCKED requires a reason). Gate integrity depends on outcomes (G4 requires evidence and artifacts for DONE deliverable tasks), not on intermediate states. See ADR-0014.

states.description: Created but not yet actionable (dependencies unmet).
Cannot proceed; a blocking condition with reason and resolution path is recorded.
Work is done; verification is in progress.
